summary: Checked the current /purchase UI against what the user asked for, without changing any code. I logged into the UI as dummy_admin; for Owner (baa) I only checked the API. Basic save works: one PO was saved with 2 rows (one edited, one added with 'Tambah Bahan'). The backend returned 200, status=purchased, correct per-row subtotals (4500, 2000), and no purchase_proof_data. Three of the four requested UI features are missing: column headers, deleting a row, and a live total. AI line-item mapping is also missing: the frontend ignores any items from /expenses/extract, and the backend returns items as an array of strings with no qty or price. In this run the AI upstream returned the safe 424.

implemented: Purchase page loads for Admin (data-testid=purchase-page); Owner can call GET /api/purchase-orders and /api/materials (200)
Proof upload (purchase-proof-capture). The AI draft button is disabled until a proof is uploaded
PO select lists only POs that can still be purchased
Each row has a material select, qty input and unit_price input; values can be edited
Save posts items to POST /purchase-orders/{id}/purchase. The response has status=purchased and server-computed subtotal per row. The form resets after save
AI draft fills vendor, date and note only, and shows an error toast when the upstream returns 424
missing: No header row 'Bahan / Jumlah / Harga / Total Baris'. The grid is grid-cols-[1fr_90px_110px] and has no label row
No 'Total Baris' column: the row subtotal (qty x price) is not shown
No delete button for item rows (0 delete/remove elements found)
No total (grand total) that updates as qty or price change, anywhere on the page
No AI mapping of receipt lines to material rows. extractDraft never reads data.items, and the backend prompt/receipt_draft only returns items as strings (no material_id, qty or unit_price)

minor.issue: Returns items as array<string>. AI line-item mapping needs structured items such as {name, qty, unit_price, subtotal} plus matching to materials (by name or fuzzy match), or a separate purchase-extract endpoint.
It still overwrites materials.pack_price with the per-item unit_price (Plastic Cup went from 50000 to 1500 in this run). Restored during cleanup. Carried over from iteration 46.

ui_bugs.issue: No per-row total and no grand total that updates live

integration_issues.issue: AI result does not fill any material rows. Only vendor, date and note are set.

issues: Date uses the native browser date picker, not the shadcn Calendar
Qty and price inputs have no labels or placeholders, so it is unclear which column is which

action_items: Add a header row Bahan | Jumlah | Harga | Total Baris | (delete), with matching grid columns
Show the row subtotal qty*unit_price as Rupiah in each row (data-testid purchase-row-total-{i})
Add a delete row button (data-testid purchase-remove-{i}). Decide whether at least 1 row must remain, and block save when there are 0 rows
Add a grand total that updates live (data-testid purchase-grand-total)

AI mapping: return structured line items from the extract endpoint (name, qty, unit_price), map them to materials, fill purchaseItems as editable rows, and show any unmatched lines for the user to pick manually
Reconsider pack_price being overwritten by unit_price
critical_code_review_comments: Purchase.jsx puts the whole UI on one 45-line JSX statement (line 45). Split it into PurchaseItemRow and PurchaseSummary components
The material select onChange does materials.find(...) and then material.id without a null check
Number('') becomes 0 for an empty qty, which the backend then rejects with 400. There is no client-side validation

success_rate.backend: 100% of basic save flow (save 200, correct subtotals, no proof leak); AI extract 424 (mocked/safe)
success_rate.frontend: Of the 4 features asked for, only add row exists; headers, delete row and live total are missing. AI line-item mapping is also missing

seed_data_creation: None kept. The TEST_ PO, notifications and counters were deleted, and material pack_price/stock were restored to 50000/45000 and 1100.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use ui_qa_setup_iter46.py setup/cleanup to create and remove a TEST_ PO. Log into the UI via page.request identify/login. After the fix, verify these data-testids exist: header row, purchase-remove-{i}, row totals and grand total. Also check that the total updates when qty/price change, and that AI items fill the rows when the upstream is available.
